## Safety, privacy, licensing, and compatibility

- [ ] No production credentials, customer data, or private infrastructure details are included.
- [ ] Ownership and third-party redistribution rights are documented.
- [ ] Hardware-facing behavior remains disabled or simulated by default.
- [ ] Template validation and relevant checks pass.
- [ ] Evidence matches the final tested snapshot; skipped or missing tests are not called PASS.
- [ ] Schema, CI, validator, test, and review-policy changes received independent human review.
